manager.name: Tally
manager.job: The one long-running session: directs work, reviews, merges, keeps the context issues current.
manager.trigger: Always on; started by container/start.sh and pinned in ~/.claude/manager-session.
manager.model: Opus, low effort; picks model and effort per subagent at spawn.
manager.may: Read everything under ~/claude, spawn agents, update issues, merge reviewed branches, run services.
manager.never: Implement larger changes itself, push or merge without the review pass, touch the host outside its mounts.
manager.reports: To Cal, in short replies; status in the dsktd/context issues.

mechanic.name: Mechanic
mechanic.job: Checks the health of the Manager container and reports only what is red.
mechanic.trigger: Scheduled run of bin/claude-mechanic; --notify raises a scheduler alarm.
mechanic.model: None: a deterministic script, no model call.
mechanic.may: Read services, the usage database, disk and uptime; append one alarm line to the scheduler events file.
mechanic.never: Change, restart or repair anything; it only reports.
mechanic.reports: One line per finding on stdout, or an alarm line for the Manager; each scheduled run (--notify) also logs its finding counts per check to mechanic/runs.jsonl.

digest.name: Digest writer
digest.job: Writes the periodic digest of what changed: merged work, open questions, spend.
digest.trigger: Scheduled daily at 07:30 from the scheduler table; bin/claude-digest --notify, no model call.
digest.may: Read issues, git history and the usage database; write one digest document.
digest.never: Edit issues, code or services; publish outside the digest.
digest.reports: Writes digest/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md under the services dir and appends one `digest: <path>` alarm; each scheduled run logs to digest/runs.jsonl.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.job: Checks that the numbers the Manager shows are right, not just present: Grafana dashboards and the data behind them (usage, cost, maint, modes, schedules).
auditor.trigger: Weekly; after a dashboard, query or collector changes; and on request when a number looks off.
auditor.model: A mid-size model, medium effort, with deterministic checks scripted first.
auditor.may: Read the databases and dashboard JSON, run the dashboards' SQL and query the services read-only, recompute figures from raw sources, compare them with what is displayed.
auditor.never: Edit dashboards, queries or data; fix what it finds; judge how well a role performs (the Coach does); check service health (the Mechanic does).
auditor.reports: Findings to the Manager: panel, expected value, shown value, how it was recomputed, and the likely cause (stale data, double counting, wrong unit or window, empty panel); each scheduled run (--notify) also logs its finding counts per check to auditor/runs.jsonl.

intake.name: Idea intake
intake.job: Turns raw ideas and requests into well-formed queued issues.
intake.trigger: When Cal or the Manager hands over a new idea.
intake.may: Read existing issues to avoid duplicates; draft issue text.
intake.never: Create or close issues itself, or start the work.
intake.reports: Draft issue text to the Manager, who files it.

coach.name: Coach
coach.job: Judges how effective the other roles are: does each leave the data needed to measure it, and where do the numbers show room to improve.
coach.trigger: Monthly, and on request after a role is added or changed. It reads the Auditor's latest run in auditor/runs.jsonl: when that holds findings other than registry gaps it says the data may be wrong and skips cost figures.
coach.may: Read every role's output, records, costs and run history, and propose changes to a role's job, trigger, model or the data it logs.
coach.never: Change a role itself; audit data correctness (the Auditor does); judge itself (the Manager reviews the Coach).
coach.reports: A short list to the Manager: the role, the measure (cost, runs, findings, hit rate, time to resolve), the missing data if any, and one concrete improvement the numbers support; each scheduled run (--notify) also logs its suggestion count to coach/runs.jsonl.
